title: Exception and Prior Authorization Terms, PrairieRx Plans
content:
Terms of the Pharmacy Benefit for prior authorization, formulary exception, quantity limit exception, step therapy exception and brand-medically-necessary requests, by PrairieRx plan.

### Timing, duration and step therapy

| PrairieRx plan | Decision within (hours after receipt of the complete request) | Approved exception lasts (calendar months from the decision date) | Approved quantity limit exception lasts (calendar months) | Preferred alternatives tried and failed for a step therapy exception | Fill history searched for those trials (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrairieRx Dual Wrap | 24 | 12 | 12 | 0 | 0 |
| PrairieRx Expansion Adult | 24 | 12 | 12 | 2 | 180 |
| PrairieRx Adult | 24 | 12 | 12 | 2 | 180 |
| PrairieRx Children | 24 | 12 | 12 | 1 | 365 |
| PrairieRx Maternity | 24 | 9 | 9 | 1 | 180 |
| PrairieRx Complex Care | 24 | 12 | 12 | 1 | 365 |
| PrairieRx Long-Term Care | 24 | 12 | 12 | 1 | 365 |

### Request requirements and notice

| PrairieRx plan | Brand-medically-necessary request needs a submitted FDA MedWatch form | Member may start an exception request | Prescriber supporting statement needed before a decision | Written denial notice mailed within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrairieRx Dual Wrap | Yes | Yes | Yes | 3 |
| PrairieRx Expansion Adult | Yes | Yes | Yes | 3 |
| PrairieRx Adult | Yes | Yes | Yes | 3 |
| PrairieRx Children | Yes | Yes | Yes | 3 |
| PrairieRx Maternity | Yes | Yes | Yes | 3 |
| PrairieRx Complex Care | Yes | Yes | Yes | 3 |
| PrairieRx Long-Term Care | Yes | Yes | Yes | 3 |

### Notes

- PrairieRx Maternity is the one plan whose approvals, including quantity limit approvals, last 9 months instead of 12.
- PrairieRx Expansion Adult and PrairieRx Adult require 2 failed preferred alternatives within 180 days; PrairieRx Dual Wrap lists 0 trials and 0 look-back days.
